external_entities.name: duty engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who uses the dispatch console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

external_entities.name: scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.

processes.name: dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers to access dispatch operations and live job status.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app and our corporate web host serves it.
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down how an engineer signs in to it.

processes.name: corporate web host
processes.description: The host that serves the dispatch console application.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API used by the console and schedule importer to access dispatch work.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
processes.notes: The API answers the console cross-origin. The allowed origins and whether credentials are allowed were not recorded.

processes.name: schedule importer
processes.description: An hourly importer that retrieves the scheduling partner's feed, parses XML, archives the document, and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.

data_stores.name: dispatch database
data_stores.description: Database containing job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: Every job order carries the token or the session that created it, and nothing about the person behind that token. How the database is protected at rest is not written down anywhere.

data_stores.name: schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder on the corporate file store where downloaded scheduling documents are written.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive, a folder on the corporate file store.

data_flows.name: load console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer opens the dispatch console in a browser and receives the application from the corporate web host.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: call dispatch API
data_flows.description: A duty engineer uses the console to call the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The console and API are served from different origins and the API answers cross-origin. The allowed CORS origins and whether credentials are allowed were not recorded.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: A duty engineer receives live job status through the console's persistent WebSocket connection to the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether it checks the engineer's session again after it is open.

data_flows.name: pull planned work
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS and parses the XML document it gets back.
data_flows.notes: Nothing was written down about how the partner identifies our importer, or how our importer identifies the partner.
data_flows.data_description: XML document containing tomorrow's planned work

data_flows.name: archive schedule document
data_flows.description: The importer writes each downloaded scheduling document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: It presents an API token. The token was issued when the importer was built and nobody has rotated it since.

data_flows.name: read and write dispatch data
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads from and writes to the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers and the schedule importer are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The same-company zone holding the live estate and authority to move crews or change depot work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: The control plane is the zone that holds the live estate; an account there can move a crew and change the work a depot does that day. It is not reachable from the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the separate company that provides planned work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database's classification is confidential because it contains crew names, crew mobile numbers, and tokens or sessions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database holds crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order; disclosure of personal data and credentials is confidential.
